description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended Acalabrutinib as monotherapy as an option for untreated chronic lymphocytic leukaemia (CLL) in adults, only if: • there is a 17p deletion or TP53 mutation, or • there is no 17p deletion or TP53 mutation, and fludarabine plus cyclophosphamide and rituximab (FCR), or bendamustine plus rituximab (BR) is unsuitable, and • the company provides the drug according to the commercial arrangement.
